caption: The drawing depicts fifteen square samples of textile patterns arranged in three columns on a beige background. The first column from the left features six small swatches stacked vertically, each with a distinct pattern: a dark square with a pale purple motif, a green square with black circle motifs, a blue-grey square with small red floral motifs, a brown-beige square with dragonfly motifs, a rusty brown square with small yellow designs, and a set of blue and white stripes with wavy lines. The second column consists of five squares aligned vertically, each with a check or plaid pattern in various colors such as pink, grey, blue, black, and red-green combinations, interspersed with smaller horizontal rectangular patches that combine stripes, dots, and bands in purple, white, black, and yellow. The third column contains three large squares, each filled with different decorative patterns: the top one features a brown grid with double orange-yellow vine motifs on black bands; the middle one has a brown background with light grey vines and two purple-pink flowers with green leaves in one corner; and the lower one shows a black background with a large silver-blue leaf, three red berries, and a yellow border with black detailing. Each swatch is distinct in color and ornamental detail, representing a range of textile designs.
title: Printed Delaines
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
